subject.title: refactor(cli): read-only database access for pure-read commands

question: Is a redacted live terminal transcript proving that converted CLI reads avoid the gateway’s writable database lifecycle sufficient for this narrow mitigation to merge?
rationale: The source change is intentionally partial and the available evidence demonstrates tests rather than the claimed concurrent runtime behavior; a maintainer must decide whether the requested live proof meets the incident’s risk bar.

options.title: Require focused live proof
options.body: Request a redacted gateway-plus-CLI terminal transcript showing no state creation or agent registration from the converted read paths before merging.

options.title: Accept test-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused regression tests and CI while treating broader concurrent-runtime validation as follow-up work under the incident issue.

recommendation.title: Require focused live proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted gateway-plus-CLI terminal transcript showing no state creation or agent registration from the converted read paths before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the proposed read-only boundary and is best positioned to provide the requested after-fix runtime evidence.
